 Share on Facebook

 VANCOUVER, BC – The 'Caps are finally back at BC Place!
 Playoff Tickets: On sale now! 
 After five straight matches on the road, Vancouver Whitecaps FC will look to further cement their spot at the top of the Western Conference this coming Wednesday, October 28 when they host San Diego FC at BC Place, with the match presented by MNP. 
 Kickoff will be at 7:30 p.m. PCT. Single match tickets are available at ticketmaster.ca/whitecaps . For all other ticket options, visit whitecapsfc.com/tickets .
 Below is important information for fans attending the match.
 ERDINGER Patio - Oktoberfest 
 Opens: 5:30 p.m. PT
 Location : Terry Fox Plaza
 Come and have an ERDINGER on the patio before the match!
 Enjoy the Oktoberfest menu
 All-Beef Hot Dog – $8.50
All-beef hot dog, soft bite bun
 Field Roast Vegan Sausage (V) – $9.50
Field Roast sausage, caramelized onions, soft bite bun
 Sizzlin' Brats – $13.75
Classic German bratwurst on a pretzel bun, served with diced onions and grainy mustard on the side
 Giant Pretzel (V) – $19.95
Served with mustard dip and house-made beer cheese dip
 Fan Zone on Terry Fox Plaza 
 Start Time : 5:30 p.m. PT
 All ages
 Kids Korner featuring airbrush tattoos, crafts and colouring, my first match certificate and more 
 Check out the BC Hydro booth to play plinko, learn about saving energy, and get a co-branded Whitecaps FC rally towel
 Games like Score on Yohei Takaoka presented by Tim Hortons
 Visit the 'Caps Cube for a chance to win Whitecaps FC prizes
 Whitecaps FC merchandise for sale
 Have a look at the Chevrolet vehicles on display and get a limited-edition Chevrolet x Whitecaps FC rally towel
 Gates 
 Public Gates: Open at 6:30 p.m. PT
 Premium Gates: Open at 6:00 p.m. PT
 Entry Tip: Turnstiles are in use. Arrive early to avoid lines!
 Player Warmups 
 Starting at 6:45 p.m. PT
 National Anthems 
 National anthems will be sung by the talented Ema Lake
 Halftime – ICBC Kick Speed Challenge 
 Pre-Match Trivia: Pay attention to the videoboard! Fans will have the opportunity to participate in trivia for a chance to be selected for the halftime activation
 Trivia winners will compete in the ICBC Halftime Kick Speed Challenge. The winner will receive $1,000 worth of Whitecaps FC merchandise
 Box Office 
 Please note that the ticket office is now located at Gate B
 Premium Entrance 
 Enter at the new Gate A Premium Entrance off Terry Fox Plaza (Level 3)
 Creekside Terrace (formerly Corner Club) 
 Enter through the new Pacific Blvd entrance, located across the street from Plaza of Nations, and take the elevator to Level 3
 You will be greeted at the Premium concierge desk and shown directly into the Creekside Terrace
 Coastal Lounge & Suites (formerly Edgewater) 
 Enter at the Gate B Premium Entrance off Terry Fox Plaza, to the left
 The concierge desk will greet you
 Supporters Section 
 All Whitecaps FC Supporters Sections (201-207 & 248-254) are strictly for home team fans
 Section 253 is general admission
 Many areas will be filled with standing, chanting and singing
 Visiting or rival team colours (San Diego FC) and expressions of visiting team support are not permitted in the Whitecaps FC Supporter Sections
 Visiting and rival team supporters may be relocated to another part of the stadium
 Stand by Me 
 Stay in your seats after every Whitecaps FC home win
 Light up your phone
 Join in the singing of Stand by Me
 Whitecaps FC Foundation 50/50 
 Proceeds from the 50/50 support the  Whitecaps FC Foundation in funding programs such as promoting youth access to soccer in underserved communities and promoting environmental sustainability
 Visit Vancouver Whitecaps FC table at section 219 or 253 for more information about the foundation or to purchase your tickets
 Tickets can also be purchased online at whitecapsfc5050.com 
 Powered by our fans and supporters, the 50/50 program supports our mission to get more kids in the on the pitch and in the game. Your 50/50 ticket purchase helps increase access to soccer and helps builds stronger, more connected communities.
 Learn More 
 Kickin' with the 'Caps, presented by Chevrolet 
 Whitecaps FC are excited to welcome the Italian Canadian Sports Federation (ICSF) to Kickin' with the 'Caps, presented by Chevrolet
 Chevrolet Subsoccer 
 Chevrolet will have the popular Subsoccer game available to play at section 209
 The game features a table with two benches facing each other, with players attempting to kick a soccer ball into the opposing player’s net below the table
Shop Online 
 Shop our online store for the full range of official Whitecaps FC merchandise.
 Shop Now (Canada) 
 Shop Now (International) 
 Merchandise 
 Locations : Sections 205, 222, 233, 249
 New Arrival : Grab the new Archive Kit and the Coastal Jersey, while supplies last
 Find more apparel at the  Official Whitecaps FC store in Gastown  (385 Water Street)
 Shop online at  whitecapsfc.com/shop , or internationally at  mlsstore.com 
 $5 Menu 
 BC Place has a $5 menu, in collaboration with Sodexo Live!
 Dawson’s Hot Dogs at sections 201 and 227
 $5 beer, hot dogs, nachos, and popcorn​
Willkommen to ERDINGER HAUS, where traditions are built. 
 It’s a party on the pitch! Located right behind the player benches, these are the best views in the house. Gather your friends, family, or clients to pour and prost together, and absorb the energy of being in the centre of the action. You’ve never experienced fußball like this.
 Get Tickets 
 Kids Combo 
 Dawson's Hot Dogs (214 and 241)
 $8.00 for a hot dog, chips, and soda
 Lions Gate Grill (215, 228 and 254)
 $8.00 for chicken strips, fries, and soda
 Last Call 
 Last call for alcohol at the 75th minute of the match
 Videoboard Special Messages 
 Fill out the form at  whitecapsfc.com/matchday/videoboard 
 All proceeds go to the Whitecaps FC Foundation
 Clear Bags/Bag Check 
 For the best stadium entry experience, Whitecaps FC and BC Place recommend fans do not bring a bag to the stadium. If you do:
 Clear plastic smaller than 12”x12”x6”
 One small opaque bag, but it can’t be larger than 6.5”x 8.5”
 Bag check is available at Gates C and H (very limited space)
 Exceptions for diaper bags and medically necessary items
 All bags will be inspected prior to entry
 Mobile Entry 
 All tickets for Whitecaps FC matches are through mobile ticketing
 Season ticket members and pack holders access tickets through  whitecapsfc.com/accountmanager 
 Single match buyers access through Ticketmaster
 Family Washrooms 
 Available at sections 203 and 230
 Gender Neutral Washrooms 
 Sections 112, 203, 216, 224-225, 230, 243
 Fan Support Text Line 
 Text 778-873-3267 at any point during the match
 Dedicated BCP Guest Services member will respond promptly
 Stroller Parking 
 Available at section 229
 Cashless Transactions 
 BC Place is a cashless venue
 All major digital forms of payment including Debit, Visa, MasterCard, AMEX, Google Pay and Apple Pay are accepted
 Cash to Card kiosk located at Sec 235
 Group tickets 
 10+ tickets
 Save up to 33%
 Get access to special experiences
 Contact groups@whitecapsfc.com 
 Kid Captain 
 Whitecaps FC are honoured to have Areeba Kirmani from Canada Scores as Kid Captain for Saturday's home match against San Diego FC. 
 Areeba is a creative and curious student at Lord Kelvin Elementary School who loves being part of Canada SCORES. When she isn't on the soccer field, you can usually find her reading or creating things at her desk or practicing her coding skills. She is known for her kindness and bright smile with a great sense of humor. She loves making new friends and is always ready to lift up her teammates and try her best. Areeba was the winner of 2026 Red Carpet Poetry Slam and is incredibly excited to represent Canada SCORES.
 Please join in welcoming Areeba to the match!
 Supporter of the Match 
 Wednesday's supporter of the match will be Noah Yan from Coastal Guardians, and his father Rocky. 
 Noah has been a Whitecaps FC supporters for three years. His favourite memory is last year’s playoff win against LAFC — it was the most exciting Whitecaps match Noah has ever experienced
 His favourite part of attending each match as part of a supporters group is cheering, singing, and celebrating together. Noah loves feeling like he’s not just watching the team, but truly part of the Whitecaps family.
